detail.quickMethodBody: A quick overview from Echo Pantry. Open the original recipe for full directions, cooking times, and temperatures.

US-01: Mix the dry ingredients, then stir in the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Spoon the batter onto a heated, greased pan.
Flip when bubbles form and cook the other side until golden.
US-02: Butter the bread and place the cheese between the slices.
Toast the sandwich in a pan over gentle heat.
Turn and cook until both sides are golden and the cheese has melted.
US-03: Mix the beef, egg, chopped onion, milk, breadcrumbs, salt, and pepper.
Shape into a loaf and spread the ketchup, brown sugar, and mustard mixture over the top.
Bake following the original recipe’s temperature and timing. Check doneness, then rest briefly before slicing.
US-04: Hard-boil the eggs, then cool, peel, and chop them.
Mix with mayonnaise, mustard, green onion, and seasonings.
US-05: Soften the onion in oil, then add the ground beef and brown it.
Stir in the seasonings, pepperoncini, brine, water, and ketchup.
Simmer until the beef is cooked through and the sauce thickens, then spoon into buns.
US-06: Mix the mayonnaise, sour cream, brine, and seasonings into a dressing.
Fold in the cooked chicken, chopped pepperoncini, and green onion.
US-07: Cut the potatoes and prepare them as directed in the original recipe.
Cook with oil, butter, lemon juice, and seasonings until tender and browned.
Finish with cheddar and green onion.
US-08: Sauté the onion, pepper, zucchini, and garlic with the spices.
Add the canned tomatoes, beans, corn, and cooked chicken; simmer until hot.
Finish with cheese, cilantro, and lime.
US-09: Cook the pasta and soften the onion, celery, and pepper.
Stir flour into the butter and vegetables, then gradually add milk and cream to make a sauce.
Melt in the cheeses, combine with the pasta, and finish as directed in the original recipe.
KR-01: Cook the bacon, then stir-fry the vegetables and kimchi.
Add the cooked rice, kimchi juice, soy sauce, and gochujang; toss until hot.
Finish with sesame oil and your chosen egg, sesame, and seaweed toppings.
KR-02: Cook the glass noodles and prepare the sauce.
Cook the beef and vegetables in batches, following the original recipe.
Toss with the noodles and sauce, then finish with sesame and egg garnish if using.
KR-03: Slice and salt the cucumber, then drain the released liquid.
Mix the chili flakes, garlic, vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil.
Toss with the cucumber, green onion, and sesame seeds.
KR-04: Bring the broth to a simmer with the tomato, cabbage, and garlic.
Add the soft tofu and season with the salted shrimp.
Pour in the beaten eggs and cook until set. Finish with green onion and sesame.
KR-05: Mix the beef with the bulgogi marinade described in the original recipe.
Cook the marinated beef with the vegetables and sauce.
KR-06: Prepare and strain the radish, onion, kelp, and mushroom broth.
Arrange the mushrooms, vegetables, tofu, and prepared noodles in a pot.
Add the broth and simmer until the vegetables and noodles are tender.
KR-07: Sauté the pork and kimchi with garlic and chili flakes.
Add kimchi juice and the liquid specified in the original recipe; simmer.
Add tofu and green onion, and finish cooking until the pork is cooked through.
IN-01: Cut the potatoes and cauliflower; prepare the onion, tomato, ginger, and garlic.
Cook the aromatics and spices, then add the potatoes and cauliflower.
Cook until tender and finish with the remaining seasonings, cilantro, and lemon.
IN-02: Prepare the spinach purée using the original recipe’s method.
Cook the onion, tomato, ginger-garlic paste, and spices into a sauce.
Add the spinach and paneer, warm gently, and finish with cream if using.
IN-03: Soak and cook the dried chickpeas according to the original recipe.
Cook the onion, ginger-garlic paste, tomato, and spices into a sauce.
Add the chickpeas and cooking liquid, simmer, and finish with cilantro.
IN-04: Rinse the lentils and cook with water, tomato, and chili until soft.
Heat the ghee and bloom the garlic, seeds, and spices.
Stir the seasoned ghee into the lentils and finish with cilantro and lemon.
IN-05: Peel the cooked eggs and prepare the onion and tomato.
Cook the aromatics and spices, then add tomato and water to make the sauce.
Add the eggs, simmer gently, and finish with herbs and cream if using.
IN-06: Rinse the rice and prepare the onion, tomato, and spices.
Sauté the aromatics, then cook the tomatoes until softened.
Add rice and the measured water from the original recipe. Cook until tender and fluff before serving.
IN-07: Rinse the rice and chop the vegetables.
Sauté the whole spices, onion, ginger-garlic paste, and vegetables.
Add rice and the measured water from the original recipe; cook covered until tender.
BR-01: Sauté the garlic in oil, then stir in the rice.
Add water and salt as directed in the original recipe. Cook covered until tender, then fluff.
BR-02: Prepare the dried beans following the original recipe’s soaking and cooking method.
Cook the bacon, sausage, onion, and garlic.
Combine with the beans and seasonings; simmer until tender and the broth thickens.
BR-03: Cut the chicken and sauté it in butter with onion and garlic.
Stir in the tomato sauce and ketchup; simmer until the chicken is cooked through.
Lower the heat and stir in the cream. Season and serve.
BR-04: Cook the potatoes and carrots until tender, then drain and cool.
Mix the mayonnaise, vinegar, mustard, and seasonings.
Fold in the vegetables and chosen additions, then chill before serving.
BR-05: Drain and slice the hearts of palm; prepare the tomatoes, onion, olives, and lettuce.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, garlic, oregano, and seasonings.
Arrange the salad, add the dressing, and finish with parsley.
BR-06: Remove tough stems and thinly slice the collard greens.
Cook the bacon, then sauté the onion and garlic.
Add the greens, toss until tender, and season to taste.
BR-07: Briefly soften the frozen açaí so it can be blended.
Blend with a little water, adding sugar only if wanted, until thick and smooth.
Spoon into a bowl and top with banana and granola.

beans.title: Lemony white beans
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
method: Warm the olive oil in a pan.
Add beans and a splash of water. Simmer for 8 minutes.

steps.title: A little preparation.
steps.body: Drain the cooked beans. Zest the lemon and chop the parsley.
steps.tip: Set the ingredients beside the stove before you begin.

steps.title: Warm the olive oil.
steps.body: Set a pan over medium-low heat. Add the olive oil and let it warm gently.
steps.tip: The oil should look glossy without smoking.

steps.title:
Let it gently
simmer.
steps.body: Add the beans and a splash of water. Cook until silky.
steps.tip: Stir gently. Add a little more water if the pan looks dry.

steps.title: Bring in the lemon.
steps.body: Take the pan off the heat. Stir in the lemon zest and a squeeze of juice.
steps.tip: Start with a little lemon juice, then taste and adjust.

steps.title: A fresh finish.
steps.body: Fold in the parsley. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
steps.tip: Keep a little parsley aside to scatter over the bowls.

steps.title: Make it a meal.
steps.body: Spoon into warm bowls and finish with a drizzle of olive oil.
steps.tip: Serve with a piece of toast if you have one.

tomato.title: Tomato & burrata
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
method: Slice the tomatoes and arrange them on a plate.
Nestle the burrata in the centre.
Finish with basil, olive oil, salt and pepper.

steps.title:
Start with something
fresh.
steps.body: Rinse the tomatoes and basil, then pat them dry.
steps.tip: Choose ripe tomatoes with a little give when gently pressed.

steps.title: Slice with care.
steps.body: Cut the tomatoes into generous slices.
steps.tip: A serrated knife makes slicing ripe tomatoes easier.

steps.title:
Build a colourful
plate.
steps.body: Arrange the tomato slices in a loose circle.
steps.tip: Overlap the slices a little so every bite has a mix of flavours.

steps.title: Add the burrata.
steps.body: Place the burrata in the centre of the tomatoes.
steps.tip: Open the burrata just before serving to keep the centre creamy.

steps.title: A little green.
steps.body: Tear the basil and scatter it over the plate.
steps.tip: Tear basil with your fingers just before adding it.

steps.title: The finishing touch.
steps.body: Drizzle with olive oil. Add salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste.
steps.tip: Serve straight away while the tomatoes are at room temperature.
